payload.title: Real-replay, live-source fault test and research-reentry validation for adaptive live fusion mesh v2
payload.work_clay: Replay current repository work events, branch feedback and dependency projections through broadcast, tag-only and CLAY_LIVE_FUSION_MESH_V2_CANDIDATE v0.2 routing; additionally inject authorized live-source observations and require complete source->normalize->KnowledgeDeltaV2->fusion->route->receiver reconstruct/use->research reentry receipts. Measure relevant-branch recall, full-payload/digest bytes, invalidation latency, stale window, false interrupts, repair success, route-cost prediction error and CPU/RAM/I/O. Execute missing dependency edges, stale projection epochs, duplicate deltas, out-of-order causal predecessors, source dropout/recovery, contradictory source pairs, burst updates and crash/restart. Compare exact canonical research-state handling against an optional approximate priority shadow that may rank routing candidates but may never mutate canonical evidence/truth/authority. Run end-to-end stage ablations so a local optimization is not accepted when the whole fusion pipeline regresses.
payload.reason_clay: Current synthetic evidence supports dependency-aware routing but leaves real replay/recovery unverified. Fresh primary research strengthens cost-based adaptive refresh selection and shows that full-pipeline stage interactions can determine realized benefit; separate research also shows bounded approximation can reduce some update costs. Clay therefore keeps canonical evidence/provenance/effect/research mutation exact and tests approximation only as a non-authoritative priority shadow. Every admitted live delta must generate a hypothesis/counterhypothesis/test/architecture/work/negative-result change or evidence-backed NO_CHANGE receipt.
payload.completion_clay: Matched real-repo and live-source replay report contains exact repo/commit/epoch/source hashes, raw rows and metadata; broadcast/tag-only/v0.2 adaptive results are matched; missing-edge/stale/duplicate/out-of-order/source-dropout/contradiction/burst/restart faults are executed; anti-entropy permanent-miss rate and repair latency are measured; receiver delivery/reconstruction/use/research-effect closure is measured; exact-vs-priority-shadow authority boundary is falsified or supported; full-pipeline stage ablations are reported; every material delta has explicit research re-entry or NO_CHANGE; candidate receives SUPPORTED, REFUTED, REVISE or NO_CHANGE verdict; affected branches receive feedback; no BASE ClayCode acceptance credit or live-fusion architectural promotion is granted from unexecuted/simulation-only evidence.
invalidators: A newer owner-fixed mesh protocol explicitly supersedes the candidate
A newer verified real execution receipt already performs the expanded matched replay and live-source fault/reentry matrix
Current repo state makes the dependency-routing or live-source model materially inapplicable
